prose:
A Techmeme excerpt attributes to Oracle a statement that it has secured funding for its OpenAI infrastructure contract and regards further vendor discussions as optional. Fetching the linked Oracle profile returned an unrelated pinned event post, not the financing statement.

The claim therefore remains supported only by the indexed excerpt in this pass. It is not independent verification of committed financing, loan terms, cash availability or the status of the underlying construction program.
highlights: Feed attributes a financing claim to Oracle
Linked profile did not show the cited statement
Successful fetch is not relevant source verification
Funding assertion differs from inspected financing documents
No terms or completion status were checked
